items.title: Gold price cool off in last two months has helped bring back demand: Titan’s Ajoy Chawla
items.description: The fall in gold prices helped stimulate demand in the category, the company said, adding that it is taking innovative steps to further create excitement for the precious metal with attractive offers like old gold exchange and lower caratage jewellery

items.title: Competition Commission of India orders antitrust probe into liquor giant Pernod Ricard's dealing with retailers
items.description: The company is also contesting a $250 million federal tax demand and faces another probe into alleged violations of New Delhi's liquor policy, which it denies.
